name: Demo Hub sample SQLite migration verification

scenarios.title: Add a status column and preserve/backfill existing user rows

checks.title: Existing records retain names and receive the declared status
checks.query: SELECT name, status FROM users ORDER BY id

checks.title: The migration adds the expected column to the users table
checks.query: SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('users') WHERE name = 'status'

scenarios.title: A migration with a valid first statement and invalid second statement rolls back atomically

checks.title: The table created before the error is absent after rollback
checks.query: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'partial_table'

checks.title: Fixture rows remain unchanged after the failed migration
checks.query: SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY id
